Lena's Year in Ohio

Exercise C

Writing: Helping at Home

Imagine you are staying with a host family abroad. Write a short diary entry (6–8 sentences) about the chores you do to help around the house. Use at least three chore expressions.

Useful chore expressions
You can use these: make my bed tidy my room load the dishwasher take out the rubbish cut the grass do the laundry set the table walk the dog
Your diary entry
Aim for 6–8 sentences. Use at least 3 chore expressions.
